claims.pins: one pin-change-capable pin (the button_pin knob; D4 in uno-light-pcint)

notes: Rebuilt 2026-10-18 from the README, board.custom.button_routes and the templates (the first copies were never committed: the repo ignores *.json by default).
requires_note: hal-2 (AI-Notes/plans/HAL_CATOM_CATALOGUE_PLAN.md): the HAL operations this isotope calls on the button pin. The isotope fits a board when every one resolves on its chip (hal.custom.project.resolve); the generated project includes only these units (polari_hal_<soc>.h). It is written against the macros, never the registers.
